selection_rule: Complete fixed fresh-symbol issuer list; all eligible event pairs in the fixed window are used without outcome-based filtering.

source_rules.acceptance_clock: SEC ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME parsed as America/New_York wall-clock; raw 14-digit value preserved
source_rules.pair_rule: For each in-window 10-K, choose the latest eligible Item 2.02 8-K with acceptance strictly after the preceding annual 10-K acceptance and less than or equal to the target 10-K acceptance.
source_rules.amendments: 10-K/A and 8-K/A are excluded from the event population; lineage/provenance is retained and unresolved lineage fails closed.
source_rules.future_data: No SEC or market observation after 2026-10-05T23:59:59Z is accepted.

feature_construction_inheritance.source_of_truth: parent frozen Q218 performance contract, inherited unchanged

outcome_inheritance.action_session: first XNYS trading session strictly after pair_closure_clock
outcome_inheritance.price_source: Yahoo Finance daily chart quote OHLC
outcome_inheritance.missingness: missing action-session open/close is DATA_INSUFFICIENT; no imputation
